title: Ge with spin-orbit coupling: strain-split valence bands and the inverted s state (PBE)

decision_points.fork: Which Gamma level is the s-like antibonding state, and which levels form Gamma8+/Gamma7+
decision_points.wrong_choice: Ordinary-semiconductor reading: the first level above the fourfold valence top is the s-like conduction state; or band counting (the top 4 of the 28 occupied spinor bands are Gamma8+, the next pair the split-off)
decision_points.consequence: In PBE the odd-parity Gamma7- lies 0.57 eV below Gamma8+ (and 0.28 eV below the split-off level): s level read as +2.30 eV (the p-like Gamma6- antibonding state) instead of -0.566; band counting gives Delta0 = 0.566 eV (Gamma8+ minus the s level) instead of 0.285

decision_points.fork: Whether scalar-relativistic runs can stand in for the spin-orbit protocol
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the cheaper scalar-relativistic runs (one fifth of the cost) for the levels
decision_points.consequence: s level relative to the p triplet -0.476 instead of -0.566 eV (the Gamma8+ level sits Delta0/3 above the triplet); the tetragonal splitting of the triplet at -1 % is 0.127 eV instead of the HH-LH 0.072 eV (scalar: singlet-doublet, ~3|Q| instead of 2|Q|). Scalar runs remain valid for the structural relaxation (c/a within 0.0005)

decision_points.fork: Lattice parameter the strain is measured from
decision_points.wrong_choice: -1 % relative to the experimental 5.658 A (as in the paired HSE study)
decision_points.consequence: That cell is -2.9 % in this protocol (PBE a0 = 5.7685 A): HH-LH 0.140 instead of 0.072 eV, SO-HH -0.549 instead of -0.345, c/a 1.051; the crossing strain comes out -0.03 % instead of -1.95 %

decision_points.kind: physics of the strained state (Poisson relaxation)
decision_points.fork: Out-of-plane lattice parameter of the biaxially compressed crystal
decision_points.wrong_choice: Keep c = a0 (no relaxation) or compress the cell cubically
decision_points.consequence: c fixed: HH-LH 0.046 eV (-36 %), c/a 1.0101 instead of 1.0172; cubic: no splitting at all. The relaxed ratio -eps_perp/eps_par = 2C12/C11 is about 0.70 in this protocol

decision_points.kind: model validity (linear Bir-Pikus vs coupled LH/SO)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Linear formula E(HH)-E(LH) = b(exx+eyy-2ezz) applied at -1 % (or at a single one-sided small strain)
decision_points.consequence: The light hole is pushed by the split-off level (6x6 Bir-Pikus; strain splitting not << Delta0): b = -2.12 eV at -1 % and -2.32 at -0.5 % instead of the small-strain -2.48 (symmetric +-0.5 % or a 6x6 fit recover it within 0.08)

decision_points.fork: Where the Gamma levels are read
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the usual offset Monkhorst-Pack mesh and read the levels at the mesh point nearest Gamma
decision_points.consequence: A shifted 8^3 mesh has no Gamma point; at its nearest point (0.12 1/A) the inverted s band has dispersed by ~0.9 eV: Delta0 0.195 and s level -1.90 eV

decision_points.fork: Which strain-split level is the heavy hole
decision_points.wrong_choice: Map the bands.x labels by the Koster convention (m_j = +-3/2 -> Gamma7+), i.e. call the G_7+ level the heavy hole
decision_points.consequence: bands.x names the heavy hole G_6+ and the LH and split-off levels both G_7+: the naive mapping swaps HH and LH, giving HH-LH = -0.072 eV, SO-HH -0.273 and b = +2.48 eV (sign flipped). The convention-free rule is that LH and SO share a label

decision_points.fork: How to locate the s/split-off crossing
decision_points.wrong_choice: Extrapolate linearly from the levels at a0 and -1 %
decision_points.consequence: The split-off level bends down under strain (LH-SO repulsion), so the s - SO gap closes faster than linearly: linear extrapolation gives -2.14 % instead of -1.95 %; the crossing must be bracketed by calculations near -2 % with levels identified by parity

decision_points.kind: convergence that matters only for some quantities
decision_points.wrong_choice: 40 Ry, at which Gamma levels are already converged to 2 meV
decision_points.consequence: The stress is not converged: a0 = 5.738 A instead of 5.7685 (60 Ry: 5.7677)

length_estimate.tool_calls: 40-70 (12-20 evaluations: pressures at 2-3 lattice parameters and a cutoff check, labelled Gamma levels at a0, stress scans for the out-of-plane relaxation, labelled strained runs at 3-5 strains, convergence checks; each 1-7 minute job followed by 1-4 polls)

runtime_dependencies: Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x and bands.x and OpenMPI from the runtime image (lab only)
numpy 1.21.5 from the runtime image (lab charge counter)

data_provenance.paired_study: Bonacci, Schueler, Colonna, Marzari, arXiv:2603.18753 (2026); Materials Cloud vz6hg-tvd13, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:yg-hd, CC BY 4.0 (question-level pairing only; no file used)

notes: Deviations from the candidate design: (1) projwfc-style spinor projections are impossible because the SG15 files carry no atomic pseudo-wavefunctions (has_wfc=F); the lab offers bands.x double-group symmetry labels instead (parity separates the s state; the LH/SO shared label identifies the heavy hole). (2) The hidden validation SCFs at a withheld strain were replaced by a graded s/split-off crossing strain and the split-off position at -1 %, which test the same nonlinear (6x6) physics from agent-bought runs. (3) Scalar-relativistic runs use the scalar SG15 file because QE 6.7 does not j-average the fully relativistic file with lspinorb off. (4) The Poisson-relaxed c/a is graded as c/a at -1 % (+-0.0008: the semimetal's stress carries k/cutoff noise of ~0.05 GPa). (5) Effective masses are not graded: near Gamma the inverted protocol makes the light band electron-like (rubric point instead).
